drills.q: Design blob tiering: heavy access 30 days, occasional a year, audit 7 years.
drills.a: Lifecycle policy Hot->Cool day 30, Cold ~day 180-365, Archive at year+ for audit; WORM immutability on audit container; ZRS baseline; watch early-deletion fees on transitions.

drills.q: Cosmos throttles at peak despite 100k RU/s provisioned. Diagnosis?
drills.a: Hot logical partition concentrating traffic - one physical partition caps ~10k RU/s regardless of total. Check per-partition normalized consumption, re-key with synthetic/hierarchical keys.

drills.q: Why can't Cosmos Strong consistency span multiple write regions?
drills.a: Strong needs RPO=0 via global-majority commits; multi-region writes with low global latency violate physics - Microsoft blocks the combination; strong multi-region write latency ~= 2x RTT furthest regions + overhead p99.

drills.q: Autoscale Tmax=50k RU/s at 15% average utilization vs manual 7.5k. Compare billing shape.
drills.a: Autoscale bills max(observed, 0.1xTmax)=5k floor hourly - valleys pay the floor; deep-valley workloads favor autoscale only if floor < manual need. Compute per hour-class from traces, never intuition.

drills.q: Postgres 'too many connections' after adding Functions consumers. Fix?
drills.a: Instances x concurrency exceeded max_connections (process-per-connection); enable built-in PgBouncer transaction pooling sized to the fleet math.

drills.q: SQL failover succeeded but app still errors. What's happening?
drills.a: DNS flipped but cached connections pin old primary; use short retry windows with connection reset, rely on retry-logic providers; async geo-replication also means possible ~5 s data loss window to design for.

drills.q: Stakeholder wants instant access to Archive-tier logs. Resolve.
drills.a: Instant = Cool/Cold tier pricing (online). Offer 90-day online + older Archive with hours-level rehydration runbook, or export queried subset to searchable store; present invoice deltas per option.

drills.q: pgvector vs AI Search for 2M-chunk RAG - pick and defend.
drills.a: pgvector HNSW comfortably handles it keeping embeddings transactional beside content metadata; switch to AI Search when semantic-ranker lift measured, faceting/security-trim needs, or scale grows beyond index comfort.

drills.q: Multi-tenant Azure SQL isolation options and progression?
drills.a: RLS single DB (cheap density, SESSION_CONTEXT predicates, noisy neighbors) -> elastic pools of per-tenant DBs (isolation + per-tenant restore) -> dedicated servers for whales/compliance. RLS risk: one missed context set reads cross-tenant silently.

drills.q: Storage Queue or Service Bus for order events? Factors.
drills.a: Service Bus for FIFO sessions, dedup windows, DLQ semantics, topics/transactions, premium VNet privacy; Storage Queues for cheap huge-volume simple decoupling with <=7-day TTL. Quantify op counts before defaulting.
